body.x: Safaud has presented its tinnitus therapy technology and puretone audiometry in 'MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT'(BOOTH # 52843) of CES 2019 EUREKA PARK held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).

Based on 20 years of clinical experience, Safaud is committed to bringing the latest IT technology to hearing loss, tinnitus, dizziness and sleep. Conventional treatment methods for tinnitus are white noise and masking using ASMR. Safaud has developed a treatment method that allows the individual to choose the right treatment option by adding a therapeutic stimulus that induces neuro-modulation of the auditory cortex to the conventional way.

Safaud's Tinnitus Therapy System provides calibrated sound for treatment that's in safe and appropriate volume according to the individual's hearing condition and allows the patient to select the most suitable treatment method by evaluating the treatment effect.

It is also possible to track and observe treatment results through cloud DB data using two THI and VAS questionnaires. In addition, it has the advantage of being continuously wearable in everyday life by being an open-type ear-level device.

Safaud is participating in CES 2019 with the support from Changwon Industry Promotion Agency, and it is looking for ways to enter the new emerging market and further spread its market to the U.S. and Europe. With the help from the clinical experts from University hospitals, it is on its way to develop smart healthcare products in hearing loss, tinnitus, dizziness and sleep.

Changwon Industry Promotion Agency is one of the institutions that is systematically designed to foster small and medium sized companies and venture companies located in Changwon area. It supports companies by hosting networking and promotion activities by inviting global investors and buyers, and participating in CES 2019 is one of its global export company fostering programs.
2019 CES is an innovative place where the tech companies that will be leading fourth industrial revolution future are attending.
